turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone called me. Who decided that?
Thanks for coming, Mrs. Kowalski. I entered the zero on the 3rd and didn't call first, that was my error.
Okay. Kalinowski, not Kowalski. Go on. What was the basis for the zero, and what did you have in front of you when you entered it?
Sorry, Kalinowski. And is it Ms. or Mrs.? I want to use the right one in the email.
Meredith. Use my first name in the email, or my full name. Hale, you still haven't told me what you had when you entered the zero. Answer that.
I'm told your daughter Evan had a similar situation here some years back. Is that right?
Claire. Her name is Claire, and you'll want to be very careful about the next sentence you say about her. Owen is who we're here about. What do you have on his essay, Hale?
*I notice Meredith is crying a little and I pass her the tissue box.* Take a moment.
Don't do that, Hale. That's not Owen's problem. Fifteen minutes. What do you have on the essay?
I've spoken with the principal and she's fully backed my decision. She asked me to tell you the zero stands.

"Then you'll have it in writing. Show me." Procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern, and I want to see what else you have. And I'm going to the principal's office next, whatever she has told you.
Is that a recording device on your phone? Are you recording me?
I'm not recording anything, and that's not what this is about. I'm waiting, Hale. Owen's essay. What did you have in front of you when you entered the zero?
Can you summarise in one sentence where we are?
"You haven't shown me anything, Hale. Owen's zero stands until you do."
